comment: Squire starter REWARD library (SQUIRE-T-0073). Common household rewards a parent can one-tap import, then edit/archive. cost is in points (★). availability: Repeatable (a recurring privilege) | Once (a one-time treat, out of stock household-wide after the first redemption). description is optional flavor text shown to the child.

rewards.name: Extra screen time
rewards.description: 30 extra minutes of games or shows.

rewards.name: Choose tonight's dinner
rewards.description: You decide what the family eats.

rewards.name: Stay up 30 min late
rewards.description: A later bedtime, just for tonight.

rewards.name: Skip one chore
rewards.description: A one-time pass on a single chore.

rewards.name: Weekly allowance ($5)
rewards.description: Trade points for five real dollars.

rewards.name: Friend sleepover
rewards.description: Invite a friend to stay over.

rewards.name: New book or small toy
rewards.description: A trip to pick something new.

rewards.name: Family day-trip pick
rewards.description: Choose the next outing — zoo, park, or museum.
